name: dev-upgrade-agents
description: Agents and a skill for upgrading existing software end to end: system-upgrader (scan, plan, sprints with commits), upgrade-evaluator (skeptical independent scoring), page-upgrader (single page or module), tool-standards-audit (audit a tool against your standards doc). Includes the system-upgrade skill with a deterministic detector, 10-dimension scoring, and Hebrew RTL, responsive and WCAG 2.2 / IS 5568 references.
